summary: Define mission-run budget windows and restrict new agent budgets to peak memory and disk

replay.detail: Replay and historical interpretation are unchanged. Historical agent readers and wire types continue retaining CPU and token budget fields.

schema.detail: No storage schema, claim kind, index, migration, backfill or wire-shape changes. The API schema description documents the budget contract without narrowing historical read types.

rules.detail: New agent authoring refuses cpu-seconds and token-budget; agents accept only peak memory-max and disk-max without an accumulation window. Mission CPU is accumulated over one mission run including all retries. Mission token-budget is the total cost-weighted tokens over that same window: sum(tokens * class price / base input price), including input, output, cache writes including 1-hour writes, and cached reads. The unit is one base input token at the pricing version pinned at admission and recorded on the run, never repriced; unknown pricing reports unknown rather than zero, with USD alongside weighted tokens. Step-run windows are a future extension. Agents have no retry/run boundary or budget window; usage belongs to routing, quota and SLO accounting. These are data-only definitions, not implemented counters, resets, aggregation, pricing capture, usage reporting, reservations or enforcement.

compatibility.detail: CLI and API new agent publication rejects CPU/token budgets with invalid-declared-admission and the corresponding budget field. No published uses were found in the supplied grep evidence: schickling/factory origin/main at b2dacb7 and dotfiles nixpkgs/smalltalk returned zero matches for declaredBudgets, tokenBudget, cpuSeconds, token-budget and cpu-seconds. This evidence is scoped to those sources. Historical readers and types remain unchanged; mission authoring retains all four budget fields.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart only; no migration or backfill.

manual.detail: No published declarations in the supplied compatibility search require migration. New agent declarations must omit CPU/token budgets; declare mission-run totals on missions instead.

recovery.detail: Rejected new agent CPU/token budgets write no declarations. Historical reads and replay are unchanged; no data recovery or repricing is introduced.
